columns.name: schema_version
columns.description: Reply table schema version. Always "1" for this version.

columns.name: platform
columns.description: Platform the capture came from.

columns.name: capture_id
columns.description: Id of the capture. Set with --capture-id (for example the sampling tracker id `{root_tweet_id}_h06_likes_A`); defaults to the input file name without extension.

columns.name: capture_file
columns.description: Input file base name (no directory).

columns.name: capture_session
columns.description: 1-based load of one thread view inside the file. A new session starts each time the thread is loaded from the top (a request without a pagination cursor), per focal tweet and sort order.

columns.name: capture_time_utc
columns.description: When the first response of this session was received (HAR startedDateTime), ISO 8601 UTC. For raw JSON input: --capture-time, else the file modification time.

columns.name: page_index
columns.description: 0-based index of the response (page) within the session that this row arrived in.

columns.name: viewer_type
columns.description: Account type of the person who captured the page. Set with --viewer-type; the parser never inspects cookies, so it cannot detect this itself.

columns.name: viewer_label
columns.description: Free-text label for the capturing persona (for example A or B). Set with --viewer-label.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.description: Reply sort the page was shown in. Read from the request's rankingMode (Relevance -> relevance, Recency -> recent, Likes -> likes) unless --sort-order is given.

columns.name: sort_order_source
columns.description: Where sort_order came from: request (rankingMode variable), flag (--sort-order), default (request sent no rankingMode, which X treats as relevance), or unknown (raw response input with no request and no flag).

columns.name: age_bucket
columns.description: Thread age bucket at capture time (for example h01, h06, h24). Set with --age-bucket.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.description: Conversation root tweet id (conversation_id_str of the focal tweet).

columns.name: focal_tweet_id
columns.description: Tweet whose reply list was captured (focalTweetId).

columns.name: focal_author_id_hash
columns.description: HMAC hash of the focal tweet author's user id.

columns.name: focal_author_followers
columns.description: Focal author follower count at capture.

columns.name: focal_author_is_blue_verified
columns.description: Focal author has a paid (blue) checkmark.

columns.name: focal_author_verified_type
columns.description: Focal author verified_type (Business, Government) when present.

columns.name: focal_author_affiliate_label
columns.description: Focal author affiliate badge text (the organisation name), when present.

columns.name: focal_view_count
columns.description: Focal tweet view count at capture.

columns.name: focal_like_count
columns.description: Focal tweet like count at capture.

columns.name: focal_reply_count
columns.description: Focal tweet reply count at capture.

columns.name: row_type
columns.description: reply: first item of a reply module (top-level reply). nested_reply: a later item in the same module. promoted: an ad injected into the reply list.

columns.name: is_promoted
columns.description: True when row_type is promoted.

columns.name: display_rank
columns.description: 1-based order of top-level organic replies in the session, counting each reply once. Null for nested replies and promoted rows.

columns.name: display_index
columns.description: 1-based order of every row in the session (replies, nested replies and ads).

columns.name: rank_is_absolute
columns.description: True when the session's first page (no cursor) was captured, so display_rank counts from the top of the thread. False when the capture began mid-thread.

columns.name: module_position
columns.description: 0-based position inside the reply module. 0 for top-level replies and standalone ads.

columns.name: conversation_section
columns.description: X's section label for the item, for example HighQuality, LowQuality or AbusiveQuality.

columns.name: sort_index
columns.description: X timeline sortIndex of the entry (64-bit, kept as text).

columns.name: tweet_id
columns.description: Reply tweet id.

columns.name: in_reply_to_tweet_id
columns.description: Parent tweet id.

columns.name: created_at_utc
columns.description: Reply creation time, ISO 8601 UTC.

columns.name: lang
columns.description: X language code of the reply.

columns.name: is_quote
columns.description: Reply quotes another post.

columns.name: has_media
columns.description: Reply carries photos, video or GIFs.

columns.name: view_count
columns.description: Views at capture. Null when X did not report views.

columns.name: like_count
columns.description: Likes at capture.

columns.name: reply_count
columns.description: Replies at capture.

columns.name: repost_count
columns.description: Reposts (retweets) at capture.

columns.name: quote_count
columns.description: Quotes at capture.

columns.name: bookmark_count
columns.description: Bookmarks at capture.

columns.name: text
columns.description: Full reply text. Only filled when the parser runs with --include-text; null otherwise.

columns.name: author_id_hash
columns.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the author's user id with the local salt (24 hex chars). Stable across captures made with the same salt.

columns.name: author_handle_hash
columns.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the lower-cased handle with the local salt (24 hex chars).

columns.name: author_is_focal_author
columns.description: Reply was written by the focal tweet's author.

columns.name: author_is_blue_verified
columns.description: Author has a paid (blue) checkmark (X Premium).

columns.name: author_verified_type
columns.description: Author verified_type (Business, Government) when present.

columns.name: author_affiliate_label
columns.description: Author affiliate badge text, when present.

columns.name: author_professional_type
columns.description: Professional account type (Creator, Business) when present.

columns.name: author_followers
columns.description: Author follower count at capture.

columns.name: author_following
columns.description: Accounts the author follows, at capture.

columns.name: author_statuses
columns.description: Author's total post count at capture.

columns.name: author_created_at_utc
columns.description: Author account creation time, ISO 8601 UTC.
